scope: Diagnostic-line inventory of the nine completed r34 build stages; no source edits or new build/tests.

detection.unit: One matching primary warning line; repeated occurrences retained.
detection.normalization: Group by text from WARNING/Warning/warning onward; strip diagnostic source-location prefix and make workspace paths relative. Examples preserve relative source locations.
detection.excluded: Compiler flags, note lines referring to a warning, and summary lines such as N warnings generated. This is not a count of independent bugs.

relation_to_r34_changes.assessment: No warning line directly names airoha_npu.c or mt7996 main/mac/mcu.c. This does not prove every diagnostic predates r34. Generic main.c diagnostics were observed in linux-atm compilation context. No full warning-causality audit performed.

major_observations: All nine build commands exited 0, but all nine logs contain warnings.

14 unique missing-feed-dependency messages recur across all nine stages (126 occurrences). Their six dependent recipes are not enabled/installed; the GStreamer recipe family also has no enabled packages.
28 empty-kmod warnings concern packages selected as m for package building but absent from the verified 206-package image; they are not installed-image missing-module findings.

Other warnings include compiler/autotools/libtool diagnostics, modpost missing MODULE_DESCRIPTION, Broadcom firmware mapping, and DTC warnings including W1700K PCI bridge ranges. They have not all been resolved or individually assessed.
Warning counts are separate from host regression PASS/FAIL counts and do not change the successful command exit codes or image-content validation.
limitations: This inventory recognizes the explicit detection pattern, not every possible diagnostic spelling.
No assertion that every warning is harmless or pre-existing.
No clean-room build, boot or wireless validation was performed by this inventory.
